field_text_formatted.value: This is part of the same push that got Field Tokens 2.0.0 and Custom Formatters 4.1.0 out the door: working through my modules one at a time and actually clearing the backlog, not just triaging it. There's more coming for JSON:API Views too, tighter access control at the route level, more performance headroom for sites well past a hundred exposed views, and eventually a 2.0.x that flips exposure from opt-out to opt-in. File (Field) Paths is next up though, tens of thousands of sites and still sitting in RC ahead of a stable 1.0.
